residual.wall: Four constraint families share one tick with no declared order or stiffness. KV, face Dirichlet, ARAP Jacobi, then stretch. Stretch undoes rotations. Face lock is a band of hundreds of hard handles. Gait is still not a constraint.

question: What constraint types exist in ARAP/PBD, which are live on Gasper’s φ, what is the lawful priority stack, and what must never be a hard lock?
coordinateSpaces: Constraints act on φ:V→R². Hard C(φ)=0. Soft C(φ)=0 with compliance α (XPBD). Face band v∈[0.32,0.58]. Pole r=0. Regional τ→α. dt=1/60.
physicalLaw: A constraint is C(φ)=0, not a second silhouette. Hard: replace the row. Soft: Δφ = −s ∇C / (∇C M^{-1} ∇C + α̃).
ARAP is an energy, not a hard C. Local R then Poisson/Jacobi. It yields to Dirichlet.
Stretch is a distance C_ij=||φ_i−φ_j||−ℓ̄. Projected after ARAP it fights the rotations (seen: pin absorbed by R until stretch was added).
KV φ←φ+k(φ*−φ) is a predict, not a constraint. Applied to locked verts it is a full-mesh Dirichlet and ARAP is a no-op.
Lawful order: predict on FREE verts → project hard (face, pole, pins) → stretch/area with α → one ARAP local-global → re-assert hard.
Compliance α̃=α/dt². τ owns α. Plant τ=0.02 is a stiffer C than swing 0.25. No extra stiffness slider.
artisticLaw: Face is hard Dirichlet. Eyes do not participate in stretch or ARAP.
A paddle rim may be a soft handle, not a welded outline. Welding the rim is a blend shape.
Gait plants are two soft handles on the rim, not stance sockets after φ.
Gel is leftover residual after a finite number of projections, not infinite stiffness.
invariants: Hard set is tiny: face band + pole + explicit pins. Not the whole 1000/3920.
φ=φ̄ and no pins ⇒ every C is satisfied; tick is identity.
Stretch never moves a hard vert. Pins pull free neighbors only.
One φ. Constraints do not write the 512. The rim is a read.
failureModes: KV on locked verts: ARAP never sees strain.
Stretch after ARAP with α=0: rotations cancelled, cells smear.
Face band too wide: the blade is welded and the shaft is the only DOF.
All-rim Dirichlet: blend shape. No fabric.
Gait as a post-pose: second writer. Constraint stack is a lie.
uncertainty: XPBD stretch+ARAP vs Igarashi energy-only for the held paddle.
Whether the face band can shrink to the actual fixture UV (eyes/mouth) instead of v∈[0.32,0.58].
How many Gauss-Seidel iters at L2 before 60 fps breaks.
tests: Hard: face verts |φ−φ*|=0 after tick. Stretch did not move them.
Soft pin: one rim vert +8, neighbors move, face |Δ|<2.
KV-free: locked verts unchanged by the predict step.
Order: re-assert hard after stretch; no hard vert drifts.
visualConsequences: A poke near the cheek ripples; the face plate is welded.
A plant is two dimples on the rim that the gel yields around.
Held paddle stays a paddle because φ̄ is the paddle, not because every vert is locked.
implementation: Explore only. Do not recut ArapSolver this receipt.
Next: name a ConstraintStack. Hard / stretch / ARAP / re-assert. KV predict skips hard verts.
Map regional τ → XPBD α. No new stiffness knob.
Gait plants become two soft pins on φ, then delete stance post-pose.
Shrink face Dirichlet to fixture UV when Investigate says so.

Handles are Dirichlet rows in the Poisson. ARAP yields to them.
